title: Matryoshka 截断：降维后的排名稳定性
expected_output:
全维度(16)排名 = [2, 1, 5, 3, 4, 0]
截断到8 排名 = [5, 2, 1, 0, 3, 4]
与全维度排名一致 = False
截断到4 排名 = [1, 2, 5, 0, 4, 3]
与全维度排名一致 = False
code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
D = 16
docs = rng.standard_normal((6, D))
q = rng.standard_normal(D)

def rank(dim):
    qn = q[:dim] / np.linalg.norm(q[:dim])
    dn = docs[:, :dim]
    dn = dn / np.linalg.norm(dn, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    s = dn @ qn
    return [i for i, _ in sorted(enumerate(s), key=lambda x: -x[1])]

full = rank(D)
print('全维度(%d)排名 =' % D, full)
for dim in (8, 4):
    r = rank(dim)
    print('截断到%d 排名 =' % dim, r)
    print('与全维度排名一致 =', r == full)
